meta.disclaimer: Hotel programs and card issuers change benefits, thresholds and award prices without much notice, and many benefits are "subject to availability" at the hotel. This guide is general education, not financial or travel advice; confirm the current terms on the program’s and issuer’s own site before you book, apply or change how you spend.
meta.statusTierNote: cards[].statusTier drives the row colors in the hub 'Status from a credit card' table: 'top' = top status, the highest standard elite tier reachable through a card (e.g. Hilton Diamond; Hilton's Diamond Reserve is a spend-plus-nights tier above it); 'perks' = a lower tier whose verified benefits (tiers[].food) include free breakfast, a food and beverage credit or lounge access; 'basic' = neither.

redemption: Marriott’s redemption page does not publish a fixed award chart. The points price for a date shows when you search with "Use Points/Awards," and the Flexible Dates option looks for the lowest points prices across a range of dates.
Stay for 5, Pay for 4: you get a complimentary night when you redeem points for five consecutive nights.
Cash + Points lets you cover part of a stay with cash to stretch your points. PointSavers are discounted points prices at selected hotels and dates.
Instant Redemption lets you pay for anything charged to the room at participating hotels; points can also buy room upgrades at select hotels, or convert to airline miles.
Chase Ultimate Rewards lists Marriott as a partner. Marriott points also transfer out to 38 airline programs, mostly at 3 points to 1 mile.

fit: The largest brand footprint means the most cities where a Marriott is near the office, and Platinum adds lounge breakfast and 4 p.m. checkout.
Stay for 5, Pay for 4 suits a week at the beach; resort benefits are more often "subject to availability."
Bevy or Brilliant hands you Gold or Platinum, which you could not reach by staying a few nights a year.
Marriott points convert to 38 airline programs, with a bonus per 60,000 points at most of them.
There are many luxury brands, but with no published chart the top properties can price high on peak dates.
notFor: Travelers who want fixed, predictable award prices: Marriott does not publish a chart.
Anyone chasing Ambassador on nights alone: it also requires $23,000 of qualifying spend.
People stacking several Marriott cards for night credits: only one personal and one business card count each year.

gems.title: Points become airline miles, with a bonus
gems.body: Marriott lists 38 airline partners, most at 3 points to 1 mile, and adds 5,000 bonus miles for every 60,000 points you transfer (10,000 for United MileagePlus). The bonus does not apply to American, Avianca or Delta. You can transfer 3,000 to 240,000 points a day.

gems.title: The fifth award night is free
gems.body: Redeem points for five consecutive nights and one night is complimentary. On a week-long trip, book the five award nights together rather than as separate reservations.

gems.title: Titanium comes with United status
gems.body: Titanium Elite includes complimentary United MileagePlus Premier Silver once you register, a rare hotel-to-airline status link.

gems.title: Choose your perk at 50 and 75 nights
gems.body: At 50 and 75 Elite Night Credits you pick an Annual Choice Benefit, such as Nightly Upgrade Awards or five extra night credits. At 75 nights the choice also includes a Free Night Award.

gems.title: Points pay the bar tab
gems.body: Instant Redemption lets you use points for anything you can charge to your room (dining, spa) at participating hotels. That is handy for a small leftover balance.

unverified: Which night is free on a five-night award (third-party guides say the lowest-priced night), and which award types are excluded, are not spelled out on marriott.com’s redemption page.
Peak and off-peak pricing: Marriott no longer publishes a chart, so we do not quote point ranges.
American Express Membership Rewards transfer ratio to Marriott (Amex partner page did not load).
Status match or status challenge: we found no standing, officially published offer on marriott.com.

redemption: Standard Room Reward prices vary with demand and the room rate, and Hilton says prices may change in real time. There are no blackout dates.

Points & Money combines points (in 1,000-point increments, starting at 5,000) with cash.
No resort fees on all-points reward stays or on card Free Night Rewards.
Points pooling lets you send up to 500,000 points a year to friends or family.

fit: Stays count as well as nights, so many short trips add up fast, and Diamond adds lounge access.
The 5th night free, no resort fees on points stays and Gold’s food credit for two all help on leisure trips.
Surpass gives Gold (food credit and upgrades) without a single stay; Aspire gives Diamond.
Hilton points are mainly for Hilton stays.
Demand-based pricing means top properties can be expensive on peak dates; Aspire’s free night helps.
notFor: Travelers who want a fixed award chart: prices move with demand.
Diamond Reserve hopefuls who stay a lot but spend little: it requires $18,000 of eligible spend on top of nights or stays.
People who relied on rolling extra nights forward: Elite Rollover Nights end after 2026.

gems.title: Status by stays, nights or spend
gems.body: Each lower tier can be reached three ways: by nights, by stays or by eligible spend. Gold is 25 nights, 15 stays or $6,000, so frequent one-night trips count fully.

gems.title: Status match with a 90-day trial
gems.body: Base and Silver members can submit proof of status and a stay with another program from the last 24 months. Approval gives Gold for 90 days; 6 nights in that window keeps Gold and 12 nights upgrades you to Diamond. You can use it once.

gems.title: Gift status at 60 and 100 nights
gems.body: At 60 nights you can gift Gold to someone, and at 100 nights you can gift Diamond. That is useful for a partner who travels with you.

gems.title: Milestone Bonuses pay at 40 nights and up
gems.body: Gold and above earn 10,000 bonus points at 40 nights and every 10 nights after, up to 180 nights, plus an extra 30,000 at 60 nights.

gems.title: Pool points with family
gems.body: You can send up to 500,000 points a year to other members, so a household can combine balances for one award.

unverified: American Express Membership Rewards transfer ratio to Hilton (Amex partner page did not load).
Exact food and beverage credit amounts by brand: hilton.com describes the benefit but amounts vary by brand and location, so we do not quote them.

We found no official fifth-night-free rule for Hyatt award stays.
We could not confirm Hyatt’s current points-plus-cash options on hyatt.com, so check there before planning around them.
Hyatt reviews hotel categories every year and announces changes in April. Reservations made before a change are honored as booked.
Chase Ultimate Rewards is the main transfer route into Hyatt.

fit: Globalist is generous, but Hyatt has fewer hotels than Marriott or Hilton, so check your usual cities.
Award stays at all-inclusive and resort brands can be strong, and Globalist breakfast helps; the footprint is smaller.
The $95 card’s Category 1–4 night and night credits are easy wins, but card status stops at Discoverist.
Hyatt is a destination for Chase points, not a way to earn miles.
The published chart with category caps makes high-end redemptions easier to plan than at dynamic-priced programs.
notFor: Travelers in cities with few or no Hyatt hotels: status only helps where you can use it.
Anyone hoping a card gets them Globalist: the card gives Discoverist and night credits, not top status.
People who want every award night at the lowest price: since May 2026 some dates price at the Upper or Top level.

gems.title: A published chart with category caps
gems.body: Hyatt says it will keep fixed point thresholds instead of dynamic award pricing. The five levels sit inside clearly defined category caps, so you can see the most a hotel can cost.

gems.title: Guest of Honor: gift Globalist benefits
gems.body: Starting at 40 qualifying nights (or 65,000 Base Points) a year, Milestone Rewards include Guest of Honor awards. They give Globalist benefits on eligible paid or award stays of up to seven nights, for you or someone you gift them to.

gems.title: Milestone Rewards keep going past 100 nights
gems.body: Hyatt’s Milestone Rewards start at 20 qualifying nights (or 35,000 Base Points) and continue every 10 nights up to 150, with choices that include points, suite upgrades and experience credits.

gems.title: Card night credits never cap
gems.body: The World of Hyatt Credit Card adds 2 qualifying night credits for every $5,000 spent, with no limit, on top of 5 credits each year.

gems.title: Early award access and point sharing announced
gems.body: In February 2026 Hyatt announced early access to award availability for Explorists, Globalists and cardmembers, and digital point sharing later in the year. Details were still to come.

ihg.cardNote: Card benefits as listed on ihg.com in October 2026; annual fees are set by Chase, so check the Chase application page. IHG’s member terms treat points from U.S. IHG credit card purchases and Chase transfers as non-elite-qualifying, so card spend helps status through night credits and spend thresholds, not points.
ihg.transfer: Chase Ultimate Rewards lists IHG One Rewards as a hotel transfer partner.
redemption: Reward Night prices move up and down like cash rates, based on room cost, the Best Flexible Rate and demand, and can change daily. Your price locks when you book. No blackout dates.
IHG cardmembers get the fourth Reward Night free on a consecutive four-night points stay at the same hotel (the no-fee card needs $5,000 spend in a year, from 2027).
Points & Cash uses some of your points and buys the rest; you need at least 5,000 points. If you cancel, the cash part is not refunded but all points come back.
Chase Ultimate Rewards lists IHG as a partner.

compare.cardPath: Premier Select or Business card: Platinum outright; Premier Select: Diamond after $25,000 spend
compare.breakfast: Diamond: free breakfast as a welcome-amenity choice
compare.gem: Cardholders get the fourth award night free

fit: A large footprint of mid-range brands, and status can be reached on points as well as nights.
The fourth night free on a four-night points stay suits long weekends; benefits at resorts vary.
Cards give up to Platinum outright and up to 20 night credits each January.
IHG points are mainly for IHG stays.
Dynamic pricing means flagship hotels can be expensive; the InterContinental Ambassador paid program adds perks there.
notFor: Travelers who count on late checkout as a status perk: the published standard is 2 p.m. at every tier.
Anyone who wants a fixed award chart: points prices move daily.
People who hope card spend points count toward status: they are non-elite-qualifying.

gems.title: Fourth award night free for cardmembers
gems.body: On a consecutive four-night points stay at the same hotel, IHG cardmembers can get the fourth Reward Night free. The no-fee card unlocks it from 2027 after $5,000 spend in a year.

gems.title: Night credits arrive every January
gems.body: IHG’s Chase cards add 5, 15 or 20 Elite Night Credits at the start of each calendar year, and the Premier and Premier Select add 2 per $5,000 spent plus 5 more at $15,000.

gems.title: Pick a lounge membership as a milestone
gems.body: At 40 and 70 nights, Milestone Rewards let you pick two rewards, including Confirmable Suite Upgrades or an Annual Lounge Membership.

gems.title: Top up your anniversary night
gems.body: The Premier and Business anniversary nights are capped at 50,000 points (60,000 on Premier Select), but you can add points from your account to use them at pricier hotels.

gems.title: Points & Cash refunds the points
gems.body: If you cancel a Points & Cash booking within the hotel’s policy, all points come back, including those you bought; only the cash part is lost.

unverified: Annual fees for the Premier, Premier Select and Business cards: not shown on ihg.com’s card page, so check Chase.
InterContinental Ambassador pricing and full benefits.
